scripts.text: [Twin Towers]
How are you? We are the Twin Towers.
scripts.translation: 最近如何？我们是双子塔。

scripts.text: It is such a pleasure to be able to meet you here.
scripts.translation: 能在这里见到你，我们非常高兴。

scripts.text: I suppose you know that this is Ragnarok Online, a land of dreams and fantasies.
scripts.translation: 想必你知道，这里是充满梦想与幻想的仙境——仙境传说Online。

scripts.text: Are you having a joyous adventure and exciting experience?
scripts.translation: 你是否正享受着快乐的冒险与刺激的体验？

scripts.text: [Twin Towers]
Although we can't move around and can't live the way you do,
scripts.translation: 虽然我们无法像你一样四处行动，

scripts.text: we love the world as much as you do!
scripts.translation: 但我们和你一样热爱这个世界！

scripts.text: [Twin Towers]
May you experience the sensation of this lovely world!
scripts.translation: 愿你尽情感受这个美丽世界！

scripts.text: For this reason, we are here at your service with our special magic.
scripts.translation: 因此，我们在此用特别的魔法为你服务。

scripts.text: Kindly let us know.
I shall accept your offer.
I'll ask for your service next time.
[Twin Towers]
Er, what a pity. Traveling by yourself is still the best evidence of adventure.
scripts.translation: 啊，真遗憾。独自旅行本身就是冒险的最佳证明。

scripts.text: Isn't this proving that you are still young?
scripts.translation: 这不正说明你依然年轻吗？

scripts.text: We respect brave hearts like this
scripts.translation: 我们敬佩这样勇敢的心

scripts.text: [Twin Towers]
There are good and bad times in life, moreover, adventure isn't an easy task in the first place.
scripts.translation: 人生有顺境也有逆境，而且冒险本来就不容易。

scripts.text: Isn't this true?
Feel free to come to us when you have time, we will always be there to serve you.
scripts.translation: 有空时尽管来找我们，我们会一直为你服务。

scripts.text: [Twin Towers]
Forget all your troubles, and create a splendid legend in this wonderful world.
scripts.translation: 忘掉所有烦恼，在这个美妙的世界里创造一段辉煌传说。

scripts.text: This is such a wonderful world, and you'll always be a great adventurer!
scripts.translation: 这是个多么美妙的世界，你永远都是出色的冒险者！

scripts.text: [Twin Towers]
The flaming passion of an adventurer,
The desire to explore the unknown realms,
The dedication and commitment to achieve the aspiration...
scripts.translation: 以及为实现理想而付出的坚持与努力...

scripts.text: You are simply a true adventurer with what compassion.
scripts.translation: 你心怀关爱，正是一位真正的冒险者。

scripts.text: [Twin Towers]
We wish to help passionate adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我们希望帮助充满热情的冒险者。

scripts.text: Although we are not able to move, luckily we have the special ability that can warp you to places of danger and excitement.
scripts.translation: 虽然我们无法移动，但幸好拥有特别的能力，可以把你传送到危险又刺激的地方。

scripts.text: [Twin Towers]
Come on! Where do you wish to go?
Just let us know you desired destination and we will send your there!
scripts.translation: 告诉我们你想去的地方，我们就会送你过去！
